english.title: Removal of / interference with immobilisation device
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) on a public road namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), without being authorised to do so in accordance with Regulation 6 of the Vehicle Excise Duty (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 1997,

(A)_[removed]_
(B)_[attempted to remove]_

an immobilisation device fixed to a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(3) of the Vehicle Excise Duty (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 1997.
